items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Replaces the arbitrary-spec existence check with per-journey coverage using the existing matching semantics.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable plans and path escapes are handled diagnostically and do not suppress valid coverage checks.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Shared discovery retains containment checks for plan and spec paths; no credentials or external inputs were added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests exercise unrelated specs, all-covered journeys, brownfield follow-ups, symlinks, and malformed-plan ordering.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The check scans the same bounded plan/spec inputs as the prior and existing journey-coverage paths.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Reusable logic now resides in shared/scripts/lib; plugin entrypoints remain intentional compatibility shims.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized producer/consumer format changed; this relocates Python implementation while preserving public CLI behavior.
